# Chi-separation support

`r2star_arlo.p` and its support routines (`use_arlo.p`,
`recover_resolution.p`, and `tukey_windowing.p`) are unmodified copies from
Chi-separation Toolbox v1.1.2, previously loaded by `script_EA5_ms.m` from the
lab's Yuting MATLAB tree. They are included only for the private-lab
toolbox-backed script reconstruction.
